It is the third installment in the "Marvel vs. Capcom" series, which features characters from Capcom's video game franchises and comic book series published by Marvel Comics.  The game debuted in Japanese and North American arcades in 1998.  It was ported to the Dreamcast and PlayStation, which was released from 1999 through 2000.
